name: Ice Cream Van
summary: Ink sketch pastel ice cream van with a serving hatch and a giant cone on the roof, side view facing right.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the tyres stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 710 px wide and 590 px tall at s = 1; use about 0.7 for a smaller scene

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin and the van bounces (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the cab faces left

author: krakujs
